deductions.kind: minor nonblocking design tradeoff, not a confirmed defect
deductions.finding: At 320px the concrete project descriptions still occupy several lines and appear again as native pins. The extra Charms detail is useful and the pins provide a repeat route; their actual scan/revisit cost is unknown. No clipping, ambiguous destination or need to equalize line counts is established.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Retain the current version unless a bounded find-a-project/revisit observation reveals hesitation. If it does, refine the specific content cue rather than imposing custom GitHub layout or stripping useful evidence.
deductions.confidence: high about rendered line density; no measured behavioral cost

deductions.kind: assurance limitation, not a demonstrated implementation defect
deductions.finding: The reviewed local DOM preview does not prove native keyboard traversal, spoken heading/image/link output, physical-phone use, published theme behavior, newcomer discovery or repeat-visit comfort. The website's complete quiet route remains a written requirement.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Verify applied profile state and the exact native/hardware paths when making those claims; review the real website independently when built. Do not count rendered fit or copy improvement as those results.

fullInstructionsReused: design-taste-frontend/taste-skill main SKILL.md read fully in independent GitHub stage
skillsWorkflow.practicalPairAgreement: Evaluate meaningful native copy and actual scrolled width/theme evidence, preserve specific facts even when paragraphs differ in length, and keep source/rendering, keyboard, speech, hardware and observed visitor tasks separate. Retain the author-controlled/host-controlled distinction and fresh review of the built website.
skillsWorkflow.exceptions: No commercial full-screen recipes, custom fonts/CSS/JS, hover layer, autoplay or mascot navigation gate inside GitHub. Static/silent artwork requires no motion controls. The future site must inherit content/identity and a complete quiet route, not a claim of behavior already tested here.

publicationBoundary: Accepted prepared local application only. No browser actions, source edits or publication were performed by this reviewer.
